dict.string: Clio requires screen recording permission to observe user workflows during demonstrations, synthesize video previews, and automate desktop tasks.
Clio requires microphone access for voice dictation and conversational companion audio input.
Clio requires Speech Recognition permission to transcribe spoken commands and conversational dialogue.
Clio requires AppleEvents permission to control and automate native macOS applications hands-free.
Clio requires Accessibility access to interact with native desktop application UI elements without displacing the cursor.
